# Chapter 21 — Certified Random Numbers and Channel Audit: Min-Entropy with a Credible Interval and Block Drift in m-qg {#sec-qjax21 .unnumbered}

**Updated:** November 22, 2026

> Rewrite of the old Ch. 18 on the basis of Ch. 1–20 (§31, §41, §42). Module: `qang.qrng` (NumPy/optional SciPy; compatible with the core). Verification: `tools/verify_cap21.py`.

---

## 21.1 Point versus certificate

$H_{\min}=-\log_2\frac{1+|qg_Z|}{2}$ (Ch. 19) evaluated at the **point** $\hat{qg}_Z=2k_0/N-1$ overestimates: with $k_0=N/2$ it gives $1.000$ bit for any $N$. The certified version takes the maximum of $|qg_Z|$ over the $99.9\%$ credible interval of the Bayes–Haar posterior $\mathrm{Beta}(1+k_0,1+N-k_0)$ (Ch. 8):
$$H_{\min}^{\text{cert}}=-\log_2\frac{1+\max(|qg_Z^{\text{lo}}|,|qg_Z^{\text{hi}}|)}{2}:\quad N=10^3\to0.866,\ 10^4\to0.956,\ 10^5\to0.986,\ 10^6\to0.9955\ \text{bit}.$$
Budget to certify $H_{\min}\ge0.99$ ($|qg_Z|\le7.0$ m-qg at $99.9\%$): $N\approx1.97\cdot10^5$ shots (`exact` for the i.i.d. model). With a real bias of $30$ m-qg ($N=2\cdot10^5$): point $0.9528$, certified $0.9431$, true $0.9574$ — the certificate is a lower bound.

## 21.2 Channel audit: stationarity of qgZ by blocks

$\chi^2$ of homogeneity of $p_0$ between blocks of $10^4$ ($19$ d.o.f.): stationary channel $27.1$; linear drift from $0\to80$ m-qg: $130.7$, with per-block readings $+7,-32,-22,-49,-71$ m-qg. The drift invalidates the i.i.d. hypothesis of §21.1 before the point value shows it (`exact` statistical). Extraction (Toeplitz/Trevisan) and certification by Bell inequalities are referenced (§41, §42), not reproduced.

## 21.5 Verification — `tools/verify_cap21.py`

```
[1] N=    10000, k0=N/2: point H_min = 1.0000 | 99.9% interval qg_Z = [-30.9, +30.9] m-qg | cert H_min = 0.9561 bit
[2] H_min ≥ 0.99 certified: |qg_Z| ≤ 7.0 m-qg ⇒ N ≈ 197358 shots
[3] real bias 30 m-qg, N=2e5: point H_min=0.9528, cert=0.9431, true=0.9574
[4] χ²(19 d.o.f.): stationary 27.1 | drift 130.7
verify_cap21: OK
```
Asserts: cert$(10^6)>0.99$, cert$(10^3)<0.9$; cert $\le$ true with bias; $\chi^2_{\text{drift}}>3\chi^2_{\text{stat}}$.

### `tests/test_qrng.py`
```python
import pytest; jax = pytest.importorskip("jax")
from qang.qrng import certified_min_entropy, point_min_entropy
def test_cert_below_point(): assert certified_min_entropy(5000, 10000) < point_min_entropy(5000, 10000)
def test_cert_grows_with_N(): assert certified_min_entropy(500000, 1000000) > certified_min_entropy(5000, 10000)
```
